fusions.name: Tongue Snap
fusions.desc: A lash that deals 12 damage, up to 1.6 times that at its maximum reach of 7 tiles, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Pond Chorus
fusions.desc: A pulse that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Muddled] for 8 seconds, its casting slowed.

fusions.name: Sudden Spring
fusions.desc: Springs you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 25% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Lie in Wait
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: you strike the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
